newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian OTC stocks gain, weekly turnover doubles.
newsitem.headline: Croatian OTC stocks gain, weekly turnover doubles.

text.p: Croatian stocks scored new gains in over-the-counter (OTC) trade in the week to April 11, with turnover rising to 7.8 million from 3.1 million kuna, the Varazdin market reported on Monday.
Weekly volume also more than doubled to 19,730 units as 26 firms traded. Fourteen issues rose, six fell and six closed flat.
The seven-stock VIN index added 2.31 percent through the week ahead of municipal elections, to end at 10,040 points.
Traders expected stronger investment in the local share market provided the polls cement the power of the ruling HDZ party.
Last week's top gainer was Podravska Banka, jumping 20.93 percent to 170 kuna though on a modest volume of 85 shares.
Liquor producer IVEX, dipping 50.88 percent to 140 kuna, was top decliner but it sold only 49 units.

Podravka food stock was again the most actively traded with 8,966 shares. It ended 5.80-percent higher at 310 kuna, 3.50 kuna above last Friday's close on the Zagreb bourse. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
